main_body: A dark, gnarled willow-like tree: a drooping brown-black canopy of hanging strands over a thick trunk with a root base, with a few green leaf specks.
top_band: No flat top surface; the canopy is a rounded organic mass whose upper rows (about 2-12) are dark brown with lighter brown highlights. The trunk flares into a dark base plinth at rows 53-55.
evidence: The kind is organic (a tree). It is not a box-like object with a top and front face. The rounded canopy and trunk read as a volumetric tree seen from slightly above, with no receding side face and no flat front-elevation panel. The organic kind passes the contract as a three-quarter tree.

style.evidence: The candidate is a dead or weeping tree. Its ramps are dark browns with a few lighter tan highlights, so it has roughly 4 steps against the 5-6 of the Beodeul leaf canopies. The outlines are dark brown, tinted to the material, not near-black. Texture comes from vertical strands, a few green and amber specks and a lighter trunk streak. The strands are narrow vertical strips with little clumping or per-leaf highlights, so the canopy is less layered than the reference. The overall value range is compressed and dark, so the form reads muddier and thinner than the reference trees. A careful artist would likely say it is a bit flatter, and when in doubt this should fail.
